topics.definition: Monolithic architecture keeps all components in one application, while microservices split functionality into independent services.
tips: Choose based on project complexity and team size.

topics.definition: An API Gateway acts as a single entry point for client requests.
tips: Handle authentication and rate limiting at the gateway.

topics.definition: WebSockets provide full-duplex, real-time communication between client and server.
tips: Use for live updates and notifications.

topics.definition: Store application state as a sequence of events instead of only the latest state.
Command Query Responsibility Segregation separates read and write operations.
tips: Use when read and write workloads differ significantly.

topics.definition: Fault tolerance enables systems to continue operating despite failures.
Observability uses logs, metrics and traces to understand system behavior.
Build scalable, resilient and observable systems using proven architectural patterns.
